title: Developer Update
description:
Work is currently underway on the next content patch. It will release in June and will be focused on changes to the economy. The goal is to make the world feel more alive.

Territories will be updated to include population and infrastructure, along with changes to factories and ports.

Naval combat is being overhauled to include battleships, submarines, destroyers, and convoys.

A global market will be built on top of importing and exporting commodities like food, iron, and coal.

There will also be greater control over the domestic economy of your nation, allowing you to directly control the production of civilian and military goods, taxes, and more.
